mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 46 degrees.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community input, will guide growth and sustainability efforts over the next several decades.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can attend yoga at Insight Wellness, catch the Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, or join the Hop Haus trivia challenge. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 3, Verona Police arrested a 19-year-old man who was found in possession of a stolen firearm following an investigation that originated from a report by the Cottage Grove Police Department.
It is a great day for a treat. Culver's opens today at 10 AM, and you can enjoy today's flavor of the day, which is Chocolate Volcano.
